newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Rao granted bail after cheating charge.
newsitem.headline: India's Rao granted bail after cheating charge.

text.p: A Delhi court granted bail to former Indian prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao on Wednesday, the same day he was formally charged with criminal conspiracy in a 1983 cheating case, court officials said.
He pleaded not guilty in the case.
Earlier on Wednesday, Rao and two other defendants were charged by a Delhi trial court judge in the cheating case.
Court officials said Rao was ordered to provide a security of 100,000 rupees ($2,801) for the bail, which would be extended until the conclusion of the trial set to start on November 26.
Rao has been formally charged in two other cases involving forgery and bribery.
A string of scandals surrounding Rao and his cabinet colleagues was largely responsible for his Congress party's worst ever defeat in this year's general elections.
